verdict.rationale: Filee is a local, offline file converter. The evidence says files never leave the computer and that it converts many formats into open ones, but that conversion feature is a different capability from exporting the user's own Filee data (presets, toolbar layouts, settings) and leaving. There is no documented export of app data or account data, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
